lines.text: Flight Night on the Rooftop. Two rounds, two dunks each, five judges, and tonight's guest leaning on the railing, waiting.
It's Flight Night, city. Two rounds, two dunks apiece, five judges who've heard every song, and a rival who came up here for you.
Lights low, stakes high. Flight Night starts now: two rounds, two dunks each, five judges at the table. Tonight's rival is warm. Are you?
You came back. Of course you did. The roof missed you.
Another night, another set. Same skyline, new chances.
Welcome back, regular. The city kept your seat warm.
Tonight's guest is here, and they came up twenty floors to take your roof.
Give it up for tonight's rival. One warm round of applause, city. Just the one.
Cass. Hits every note, never plays a solo. Expect the tomahawk, on schedule.
Ty. Few words, heavy dunks. When that windmill comes around, hold onto the railing.
Pilot. Listens to the whole room before playing a note. Then the three-sixty.
Zo. Doesn't need the trophy, just the clip. Every phone in the tower is already recording.
Stack. The riskiest dunk in the building, attempted first, with a grin. Between the legs, naturally.
You're on, headliner. The city's tuned in.
Spotlight's yours. Make it worth the stairs.
Low lights. All eyes on you.
All right. Give the skyline a reason.
Here's your moment. Make it smooth.
Run it back. Same song, better take.
Second take. The tape's still rolling.
No rush. The night is young.
Again. Slower this time... smoother.
Last take. Make it the one they play.
Final attempt. Even the traffic went quiet.
This is it. No encore after this one.
Let it fly.
Quiet, city.
Go on.
Easy... now.
Watch this.
It counts. That's all I'll say.
Clean enough. The skyline shrugs.
Fine. Filed under fine.
A make is a make.
Tidy. Not a love song, but tidy.
Down it goes. Polite applause, please.
Ooh. Now that one had a groove.
Smooth. Late-night smooth.
That one had a little shine.
The string lights flickered for that one.
Oh, that swung. That really swung.
Somebody at the judges' table just smiled.
Lovely. Put that one on the radio.
Right in the pocket. Right on the beat.
Okay! Now I'm raising my voice!
Whoa! The whole skyline saw that!
Turn me up! Turn the whole city up!
Call the station! Wait, we are the station!
Every window on the block just lit up!
Unbelievable! Somebody check the roof for cracks!
Stop the music! Nobody move!
Oh, the city is on its feet!
Goodness! The neighbors are on their balconies!
Ha! That one's going in the time capsule!
Fifty. Say it slowly, city. Fifty.
A perfect fifty. Put it up in lights.
Five tens! The whole skyline stands up!
Perfection. The highest thing on this roof tonight.
Heard that song already. The judges want new music.
A rerun? At this hour? The judges noticed.
Same dunk, second time. Encores score lower up here.
The table's seen that one. Bring something they haven't.
Oh. The city saw that too.
No. Not tonight, anyway.
That's a sour note.
Missed. Keep that one off the radio.
Close. Close doesn't play on this station.
Well. We'll edit that out of the replay.
In and out. So close, so rude.
Iron. The whole block heard that clang.
Rattled, then refused. Cold iron.
The lob wandered off into the night.
Gone. That ball caught a cab home.
Lost the toss. The dunk never showed up.
Clipped it. That's a scratch on the record.
Touched the prop. The judges saw it.
A little contact on the way over. No.
That's the last take. The judges mark it a miss.
Out of attempts. We'll call that one a rehearsal.
No more tries. Scored as a miss, filed away quietly.
Judges, your verdict?
The table's talking.
Cards, please.
Take it away, table.
Your rival's turn. Try not to watch.
Tonight's guest is up. Let's see it.
Cass is up. Expect it on time.
Ty steps up. Mind the glass, city.
Pilot's up, taking the room's temperature.
Zo is up. Somebody's already filming.
Stack's up. Not even Stack knows what's next.
Fine. I'll admit it. That was good.
Smooth reply from the other side...
Annoyingly good, that...
Well. The guest brought a song...
Cass, right on schedule. Of course.
Ty, heavy as the late train...
Pilot waited for the downbeat, then...
Zo got the highlight. Phones got it too.
Stack jumped without a net, and landed...
Oh, tonight's guest missed. Pity.
No good. Your spotlight, if you want it.
Missed it. I'd say sorry, but I'm not.
Off-key. Your rival hit a wrong note.
That one stays off the playlist.
Round two. The late set. This is where the night gets decided.
Final round, city. Everybody lean in close.
Second set, last set. Make it memorable.
You're behind, and quiet dunks won't do it. Make some noise.
Down on the cards. Time for something the city's never seen.
Behind going into the late set. Big numbers only, headliner.
You're ahead. Close it out smooth, like the last song.
Leading into the late set. Play it cool and finish the song.
Flight Night is yours. Tonight the city goes to sleep saying your name.
Champion of the Rooftop! Yes, I'm yelling! I'm allowed to yell for this!
You outflew tonight's guest and won over five tough judges. Enjoy the view from up here.
This roof has a new headliner. Flight Night winner, take your bow.
Tonight's guest takes Flight Night. Be gracious, then come back for it.
Close, but the cards said no. The roof will be here tomorrow night.
The rival leaves with the win. You leave with a reason to return.
Judges went the other way. Every great act has an off night. Encore soon.
Splits on the concrete? Now that's commitment.
Over? Yes. The city signs off on that.
Go on, roar. The whole block heard it.
Calling the rim too small? Bold. Earned.
Arms up. The string lights approve.
Pass the controller. Next hooper, you're on.
Smooth handoff, please. Your set now.
Player one, the stage is yours.
Controller to player two. You're on the air.
Duel's settled. Somebody owns bragging rights till sunrise.
Player one takes the duel. Sleep well, player two.
It's player two's night. Player one, rematch at midnight?
A tie. Perfect harmony, no soloist. What a standoff.
Even. Perfectly even. The skyline can't pick a side.
